capabilities: dictate text live with local speech models
transcribe local audio and video files
translate selections or whole notes locally
read notes aloud with local voices
extras: Renamed from Local Dictation; existing installs, settings, and hotkeys carry over. Desktop only, mobile not supported. Optional remote LLM providers may require accounts or usage fees; audio is never uploaded. Some third-party models require reviewing license terms before installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in offline speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or translation, so these jobs usually require cloud services or separate apps.

relations.evidence: File transcription or batch dictation | Whisper or Cohere Transcribe
Import YouTube captions: Paste a link and bring available captions into your note

summary: Local speech toolkit that dictates text, transcribes audio and video files, imports YouTube captions, translates text, and reads notes aloud.
